datasets.name: Bi-temporal very-high-resolution (VHR) optical remote sensing images of Lantau Island, Hong Kong

methods.name: GAN-based Siamese framework (GSF)
methods.summary: A cascaded framework for landslide inventory mapping consisting of two modules: a domain adaptation module using a conditional GAN to translate pre-landslide images to the post-landslide domain, and a landslide detection module using a fully convolutional Siamese network to perform pixel-level comparison and detection.
methods.source: Bo Fang, Gang Chen, Li Pan, Rong Kou, and Lizhe Wang
methods.verbatim: we propose an end-to-end GAN-based Siamese framework (GSF) for LIM using bi-temporal optical remote sensing images.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and input imagery are not referenced or linked, and the custom GAN-based Siamese framework code is not provided.
